name: Sword & Shield Factory
summary:
Welcome to Sword & Shield Factory, the ultimate arcade idle VR experience where you take control of a medieval weapon workshop! As a master blacksmith, your goal is to forge powerful swords and indestructible shields while expanding your factory to legendary status. Gather rare materials, upgrade your tools, and automate production to increase efficiency. Unlock powerful blueprints and craft unique weapons fit for kings and warriors.
